name: steam-account-manager-app
description: Manage isolated Steam accounts and launch shared websites in per-account persistent browser profiles.
author: Steam Account Manager App

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node packaging/build-native.cjs win32 && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:linux: node packaging/require-linux.cjs && npm run build && node packaging/build-native.cjs linux && node packaging/prepare-linux-uninstall.cjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.test:database: npm run build:main && node packaging/electron-node.cjs packaging/database-test.cjs
